tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The window and every screen's ground. Light is an iPhone addition: Sangam's app is dark only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, names, what you type, the recommended option's fill. On bg, chip and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Secondary words: chips, decision text, card details. On bg, chip and surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, times, placeholders, the attention line, folded steps. Dark is Sangam's exact value: 3.9:1 on bg, below 4.5:1 for small text, kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Group labels (Pinned, Recent, a task page's section titles).

tokens.name: item
tokens.usage: The rows under a label; Oby's words; option pill text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Outlines at rest: the message box, a task card in a conversation, tabs' base line.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: An outline hovered or pressed.

tokens.name: line-focus
tokens.usage: A focused text field.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Lines between panels, between rows of a settings card, over a card's decision.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: A row or icon under the pointer, or pressed on iPhone.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: The selected row or the open icon.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Task cards, settings-free cards, Oby's question card, the decision bubble.

tokens.name: chip-hover
tokens.usage: A card pressed; a composer tag's fill.

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: Home's chips, option pills, the stage bar's empty segments.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: Your message bubble, the message a task came in on, file tags you sent.

tokens.name: card-fill
tokens.usage: A task or artifact card under Oby's words (edged in line).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Menus, the + panel, sheets, modals and Settings' cards.

tokens.name: surface-edge
tokens.usage: A popover's or settings card's edge and the lines inside it.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text fields and pop-up menus: their fill.

tokens.name: field-edge-on
tokens.usage: A field or the message box focused.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet or modal.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: The monospace block in a decision (the command, the diff stat).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: A switch that is off.

tokens.name: meter
tokens.usage: A usage bar's track.

tokens.name: stage-done
tokens.usage: Done and current segments of the stage bar.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The grey check of a done task, the check of a step taken, a skipped stage's dash, the dotted stage line.

tokens.name: pulse
tokens.usage: The working dot, pulsing 20% to 100% every 1.6s.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (the recommended option, the primary button).

tokens.name: unread
tokens.usage: New: a task you have not opened, an unread conversation. Dots only.

tokens.name: needs
tokens.usage: Needs you: a decision is yours. Dots, the stage bar's current segment.

tokens.name: needs-ink
tokens.usage: The decision's kind label (Question, Permission, Start it?) as text. Light needs a darker orange to read.

tokens.name: full
tokens.usage: An account past 80% used: the gauge's dot, its bar.

tokens.name: over
tokens.usage: An account past 90% used.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Delete, Deny, Stop) and a failed stage or decision.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: A stage done (the green circle with a check), Connected's dot.

tokens.name: tok-link
tokens.usage: Links and references (#412) in what Oby says and what you type.

tokens.name: tok-mention
tokens.usage: An @Oby named in the words.

tokens.name: tok-mention-bg
tokens.usage: Behind an @mention and an invited address.

tokens.name: tok-path
tokens.usage: Paths, repos, commands and `code` in what Oby says and in tool lines (monospace, a size down).

tokens.name: tok-path-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a path or code token.

tokens.name: oby-body
tokens.usage: Oby's face: the same in both themes (Oby is always white).

tokens.name: oby-eye
tokens.usage: Oby's eyes.

tokens.name: oby-edge
tokens.usage: A hairline round the small flat face on a light ground, so the white face holds its shape.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: A page's title: a kind of work (Review PR), Tasks, Inbox, Settings.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A side panel section's title (Home, Conversations).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: A task's own page; someone else's Oby.

styles.name: report
styles.usage: A done task's report under Result.
styles.sample: INVITE_TTL was in seconds but read as minutes.

styles.name: compose
styles.usage: What you type in the message box, and its placeholder.
styles.sample: What do you want me to work on, Ana?

styles.name: body
styles.usage: What you read: Oby's words, bubbles, chips, row names, settings rows.
styles.sample: Yes, it went out with 0.9 on Tuesday.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: A decision's headline, a stage's name, a conversation row's name.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines (agent · account · repo), the live step, tool lines, folded steps.

styles.name: small-strong
styles.usage: A task card's title inside a conversation; settings group heads.
styles.sample: Fix the live panel's queue order

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Times ago, counts, group labels, the decision's kind (at 500).

styles.name: time
styles.usage: A message's time under the end of its run.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: A decision's code block; a session's tool names.

styles.name: mono-inline
styles.usage: Paths and code inside a 14px line, and a branch in a task's details.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between runs of one side's messages; chip dots apart.

tokens.name: space-1h
tokens.usage: Between your parts and tags; a time under its run.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between cards in a list, chips apart, option pills apart.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between the parts of one Oby answer; a step line under the face.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Oby answering under your message; a card's decision padding.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side margin of every screen; a task card's side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: A question and its answer apart; Settings groups 28px apart.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The title bar's height on Mac; 44px on iPhone under the safe area.

tokens.name: composer-line
tokens.usage: The message box's line height (one line: 46px tall box).

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: iPhone's smallest touch target; visual 32px buttons get a 44px hit area.

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: iPhone 17 Pro status bar and Dynamic Island inset.

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: iPhone home indicator inset; the message box sits 8px above it.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline path and code tokens; a tag's thumbnail.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Side panel rows, menu items, crumbs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, settings buttons, fields, the segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-code
tokens.usage: A decision's code block; search fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Archive rows, modal fields, the invite link, file tags.

tokens.name: radius-card-sm
tokens.usage: A task or artifact card in a conversation; photos sent.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Settings' cards and menus.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Bubbles, the decision card, Oby's question card.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The + panel, modals; an iPhone sheet's top corners (on a 28px device curve).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: A task card in a list.

tokens.name: radius-composer
tokens.usage: The message box (half its 46px height).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, option pills, a tag.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and the + panel.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and sheets.
